name: Sticky Teriyaki Chicken

cookingMeasurement.name: Jasmine rice
cookingMeasurement.note: Uncooked; USDA long-grain white rice proxy

cookingMeasurement.name: Teriyaki sauce
cookingMeasurement.note: Generic ready-to-serve sauce; brand not specified

nutritionNotes: Ingredient-calculated estimate for 4 equal servings, using USDA FoodData Central SR Legacy records. Chicken is weighed raw, skinless and boneless; 250 g jasmine rice uses uncooked enriched long-grain white rice as the closest USDA proxy. Generic ready-to-serve teriyaki sauce: 1 tbsp = 18 g; with the confirmed 15 ml tablespoon, 80 ml = 96 g. Soy sauce: 16 g/tbsp; honey: 21 g/tbsp; minced garlic: 2.8 g/tsp. All listed sauce is counted as eaten. Sauce brands and retained sauce vary. Sesame seeds, spring onion, optional extra sauce and unspecified frying oil are excluded from nutrition and generated grocery quantities. Soy sauce and the teriyaki proxy contain soy and wheat; sesame garnish remains relevant to allergy checks. Source-reported macros supplied with the recipe: approximately 520 kcal, 48 g protein, 60 g carbs, 9 g fat per serving; unverified and retained for comparison, not used as the calculated totals. The generated cover is illustrative.
notes:
1. Cook rice according to packet instructions.
2. Fry the diced chicken in a pan until golden and cooked through; check the thickest pieces reach 74°C (165°F).
3. Add garlic, soy sauce, honey, and teriyaki sauce.
4. Simmer for 3–4 minutes until sticky.
5. Portion with rice and top with sesame seeds and spring onion.
6. Add an extra sauce pot if desired.

cookingMeasurement.name: Yellow pepper
cookingMeasurement.note: Large pepper assumed; USDA available whole-pepper measure

cookingMeasurement.name: Red onion
cookingMeasurement.note: Half a medium onion; generic raw onion proxy

cookingMeasurement.name: Smoked paprika
cookingMeasurement.note: Ordinary paprika is the closest USDA proxy

nutritionNotes: Ingredient-calculated estimate for 4 equal servings. USDA FoodData Central SR Legacy records plus Foundation drained-and-rinsed black beans (FDC 2644285); Foundation energy uses Atwater Specific Factors, normalized to existing two-decimal catalog storage. Chicken is weighed raw, skinless and boneless. Confirmed assumptions: 240 g drained black beans and 285 g drained sweetcorn per tin. Pepper sizes were unspecified: one medium red pepper = 119 g; one large yellow pepper = 186 g using USDA household weights. Half a medium onion = 55 g; generic raw onion is the closest proxy for red onion. Smoked paprika uses ordinary paprika at 2.3 g/tsp; garlic powder = 3.1 g/tsp. Fresh coriander and unspecified frying oil are excluded from nutrition and generated grocery quantities. No rice, tortilla, dressing or extra sauce is included. Bean fiber is unavailable in the chosen Foundation record and is not invented. Source-reported macros supplied with the recipe: approximately 480 kcal, 50 g protein, 35 g carbs, 9 g fat per serving; unverified and retained for comparison, not used as the calculated totals. The generated cover is illustrative.
notes:
1. Season chicken with smoked paprika and garlic powder.
2. Pan-fry for 8–10 minutes, or until cooked through, then slice. Check the thickest part reaches 74°C (165°F); time varies with thickness.
3. Mix beans, corn, peppers, onion, and coriander.
4. Divide into containers and top with chicken.
